name: DC transfer-reference calibration against an INRIM4.2 K programmable Josephson standard
plain_name: Realize and compare a quantum-accurate DC voltage reference
description: Realize and compare a quantum-accurate DC voltage reference. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

A PJVS array and its microwave/bias control are essential. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
